name: GhostTree
description: Headless APG Tree View root (role="tree", default <ul>). Owns controlled/uncontrolled single or multiple selection (v-model) and expansion (v-model:expanded) through useControllableState, a single roving tab stop over visible enabled items in rendered DOM order, RTL-aware hierarchical arrow keys, Home/End, * sibling expansion, 500ms IME-safe typeahead, and focus recovery when an ancestor collapses or the focused item unmounts. Never mutates consumer data.

props.name: allowDeselect
props.description: In single mode, re-activating the selected node clears the selection.

props.name: as
props.description: Tag name or component rendered for the `role="tree"` container.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Initial expanded branch values when `expanded` is omitted.

props.name: dir
props.description: Explicit writing direction; otherwise inherited from `[dir]`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every interaction in the tree.

props.name: expandOnClick
props.description: Pointer clicks on a branch row also toggle expansion.

props.name: loop
props.description: `ArrowDown` / `ArrowUp` wrap at the ends of the visible node list.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: Controlled selection (`v-model`). Omit for uncontrolled mode.

slots.name: default
slots.description: GhostTreeItem nodes; receives selection, expansion, and focus state plus select/toggle helpers.

exposed.name: focus
exposed.description: Focuses the current roving tab stop item, if any.

attributes.name: data-ghost-tree
attributes.description: Marker present on the GhostTree root.

attributes.name: data-dir
attributes.description: Resolved writing direction on the GhostTree root.

attributes.name: data-disabled
attributes.description: Present on the root when the whole tree is disabled.

keyboard.Tab: Moves focus into and out of the tree through its single roving tab stop.
keyboard.ArrowDown: Moves focus to the next visible enabled item without changing selection; wraps only when loop is true.
keyboard.ArrowUp: Moves focus to the previous visible enabled item without changing selection; wraps only when loop is true.
keyboard.ArrowRight: LTR: expands a closed branch, or moves to the first visible enabled child of an open branch. RTL: collapses an open branch, or moves to the closest visible enabled ancestor.
keyboard.ArrowLeft: LTR: collapses an open branch, or moves to the closest visible enabled ancestor. RTL: expands a closed branch, or moves to the first visible enabled child of an open branch.
keyboard.Home: Moves focus to the first visible enabled item.
keyboard.End: Moves focus to the last visible enabled item.
keyboard.Enter: Selects the focused item (single), deselects it when allowDeselect is true, or toggles it (multiple). Never toggles expansion.
Same as Enter when no typeahead query is active; otherwise appends a space to the query.
keyboard.*: Expands every closed enabled sibling branch of the focused item in one update.
keyboard.a-z: Printable characters run a 500ms typeahead over visible enabled items, moving focus without selecting.
